# Current state guide

This benchmark exists to answer one question: do dendrites (PerforatedAI perforated
backpropagation) make a model hold up better under quantization than the same model
without them? Everything below is generated from the code that runs the experiment, so
it describes what the repository does today rather than what an earlier run did.

Regenerate with `uv run dqb docs`; verify in CI with `uv run dqb docs --check`.

Sources of truth: `src/dendritic_benchmark/specs.py`, `model_adapters.py`, `artifacts.py`, `statistics.py`, and the `cli.py` option registry.

## What makes a result reportable

Every attempt writes `artifact_manifest.json` (schema version 1) binding one immutable artifact identity to the SHA-256 of every file it owns. Reporting reads that verdict; it never infers validity from the presence of files on disk.

| gate | requirement |
|---|---|
| artifact | manifest is finalized, its identity matches the record, and every manifest-owned file still hashes to the recorded digest |
| dendritic arm | dendrite audit status is `verified_retained` or `inherited_verified_retained`, and the manifest agrees with the record |
| quantized arm | the artifact carries the current quantization-evaluation revision and a `current` quantization status |
| effect claim | at least 3 paired seeds against the dense control, significant at p < 0.05 |

`compare` writes two audit tables next to the comparison plots: `dendrite_audit.csv` (per-arm validity, requested vs observed switch schedule, termination reason, seed-paired effect verdict) and `dendrite_effect_statistics.csv` (paired seeds, noise floor, mean improvement, p-value, verdict). A dendritic arm with fewer than 3 paired seeds is reported as `insufficient_seeds` and must not be quoted as a win.

## Command reference

Generated from the argparse registry. `dqb --help` and `dqb <command> --help` print the same options with their full text.

### Shared options

| option | default | purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `--results-root` | `results` | Root directory where per-model result folders are written. |
| `--results-directory` | — | Optional directory name under --results-root to scope a training run or analysis set. |
| `--logging-dir` | `logs` | Directory where timestamped log files are written. |

### `dqb run`

Runs the full benchmark pipeline: trains each selected model under each selected condition, evaluates it, and writes JSON records plus plots to --results-root.

| option | default | purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `--comparison-root` | `comparison` | Root directory for cross-model comparison outputs such as summary CSVs and aggregate plots. |
| `--models` | — | Space-separated list of model keys to include. |
| `--conditions` | — | Space-separated list of condition keys to include. |
| `--ignore-saved-models` | flag | Redo training for all selected model/condition pairs even if a record.json already exists on disk. |
| `--allow-PQAT` | flag | Enable post-quantization-aware training for all quantized conditions. |
| `--dynamic-dendritic-training` | flag | Use PerforatedAI's open-ended dynamic FP32 dendritic training mode. |
| `--pai-capacity-check` | flag | Run PAI's built-in seven-epoch dendrite-capacity diagnostic. |
| `--model-scale` | `1.0` | Scale the width of the compact-capable benchmark models before training. |
| `--pai-variant` | `default` | Select a measured PAI targeting ablation. |
| `--pai-fixed-switch-interval` | — | Diagnostic only: force PAI's fixed-switch mode at the requested interval for dendritic search. |
| `--recipe-override` | — | Load a dendritic_benchmark.plans.RecipeOverride from this JSON file and apply it on top of the selected model's hard-coded ModelTrainingRecipe. |
| `--pai-override` | — | Load a dendritic_benchmark.plans.PAIOverride from this JSON file to override the selected model's target modules or explicitly override PerforatedAI's library-owned schedule. |
| `-j`, `--jobs` | `4` | Number of worker processes to split the selected models across. |
| `-i`, `--interval` | `60` | Seconds between progress tables while waiting on the workers. |
| `--fresh` | flag | Delete any leftover epoch_checkpoint.pt (and its condition directory) for the selected pairs before launching. |
| `--seed` | — | Seed Python, NumPy and torch RNGs before every model/condition. |
| `--detach` | `watch` | Launch the workers and exit immediately. |
| `--status` | — | Report on the workers recorded in --logging-dir without launching anything, then exit. |

### `dqb download_data`

Downloads and caches all datasets required by the selected models.

| option | default | purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `--models` | — | Space-separated list of model keys whose datasets should be downloaded. |
| `--strict` | flag | Abort immediately on the first download failure instead of continuing and reporting all failures at the end. |

### `dqb pretrain_kd_teacher`

Reproduces `train_perforated_resnet_KD.py --pre-train-teacher` from PerforatedAI's resnet example: an ImageNet ResNet-50 with a fresh 100-way head, fine-tuned on the same CIFAR-100 train subset the student sees, checkpointed at its best validation accuracy.

| option | default | purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `--epochs` | `90` | Teacher fine-tuning epochs (upstream default: 90). |
| `--batch-size` | `32` | Teacher batch size (upstream: 32). |
| `--lr` | `0.0125` | Teacher SGD learning rate (upstream: 0.0125 with StepLR(30, 0.1)). |
| `--force` | flag | Retrain and overwrite an existing teacher checkpoint. |

### `dqb compare`

Reads all JSON training records from --results-root and produces:

| option | default | purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `--comparison-root` | `comparison` | Root directory for cross-model comparison outputs such as summary CSVs and aggregate plots. |
| `--manifest` | flag | Rewrite the manifest CSV (results/manifest.csv) from the current training records before generating plots. |
| `--benchmark-root` | `benchmarks` | Root directory containing benchmark outputs (manifest.csv) used to build latency comparison plots in --comparison-root. |
| `--models` | — | Space-separated list of model keys to restrict the aggregate comparison plots (heatmaps, dendrite delta, summary.csv) to — e.g. so a heatmap over a handful of trained models doesn't carry blank rows for every model that was never run. |
| `--seed-roots` | — | Additional results roots holding the same models and conditions under different seeds. |

### `dqb generate_graphs`

Walks --results-root and renders a training-curve PNG for every saved training record that does not yet have one.

| option | default | purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `--regenerate-graphs` | flag | Overwrite graph files that already exist on disk. |

### `dqb benchmark_models`

Measures wall-clock inference latency for all trained models and conditions.

| option | default | purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `--benchmark-root` | `benchmarks` | Root directory where benchmark results are written. |
| `--comparison-root` | `comparison` | Root directory for per-model comparison plots. |
| `--models` | — | Space-separated list of model keys to benchmark. |
| `--conditions` | — | Space-separated list of condition keys to benchmark. |
| `--batch-sizes` | `[1, 32]` | Space-separated list of batch sizes to test. |
| `--num-runs` | `5` | Number of independent timing runs per batch size. |
| `--re-run` | flag | Re-benchmark all selected model/condition pairs even if a result JSON already exists on disk. |

### `dqb clean`

Reads .dqb/command_config.json and removes the output directories and files recorded by previous 'uv run dqb' commands.

| option | default | purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | flag | Print the paths that would be removed without deleting anything. |

### `dqb docs`

Renders information/CURRENT_GUIDE.md from the model/condition specs, the artifact-validity rules, and this CLI's own option registry, so the current documentation cannot drift from the code that runs the experiment.

| option | default | purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `--output` | `information/CURRENT_GUIDE.md` | Path to write the generated guide to. |
| `--check` | flag | Do not write anything; exit non-zero when the checked-in guide no longer matches the registries. |

### `dqb evidence_index`

Walks the generated roots, records every training record it finds with its run namespace, artifact id, seed, metric, and manifest verdict, and writes both a machine-readable JSON index and a markdown summary.

| option | default | purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `--roots` | — | Generated roots to index. |
| `--verify` | flag | Re-hash every manifest-owned file instead of only reading the provenance files. |
| `--json-output` | `information/evidence_index.json` | Path for the machine-readable index. |
| `--markdown-output` | `information/EVIDENCE_INDEX.md` | Path for the readable summary. |

## Where the rest of the documentation lives

- `information/HISTORICAL_INDEX.md` — every document in `information/`, its status (current, historical, or superseded), and what it may still be cited for.
- `information/RETENTION_POLICY.md` — which generated trees are canonical evidence, which are disposable cache, and what has to exist before anything is deleted.
- `information/DENDRITE_EFFECT_AUDIT_2026-08-30.md` — the current scientific verdict on whether dendrites beat noise and more training.
- `information/audit/` — the cleanup audit and its priority ledger.

Historical run reports keep their original numbers on purpose. When they disagree with this file, this file is the current state and they are evidence of what was true when they were written.
